content.short: Create, fund and deliver the future of Cardano.
content.description: Project Catalyst is an experiment in community innovation, providing a framework to turn ideas into impactful real world projects. We're putting the community at the heart of Cardano's future development. Are you ready for the Challenge? A proposer is someone who submits a proposal to Cardano Project Catalyst to be funded by the treasury. They have an understanding of a problem and an idea on how to solve it. Proposers are the ideas people, ones that see the bigger picture, identify needs, look to plug gaps. They are visionaries.
content.meta: Find out about Project Catalyst (ADA) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
